reviews.comment: I took Professor Sze during the summer, which is a little more accelerated version of MATH 151. He often fell behind and seemed to take that frustration out on students. During office hours, he was dismissive when I asked for help. His exams were much harder than past exams, despite recommending students use them to study.

He explains concepts really simply, but it can be fast-paced sometimes. His exams are similar to practice exams and quizzes. If you want to be successful in this class, I'd definitely recommend doing all of the practice exams, redoing quizzes, completing the week-in review, and reviewing the homework :)
If you had him for 140 and hated him, why take him again for 142? There are many professors to choose from.  I only had him for 142 and all I could say is he is miles better than my 140 professor.

I had him for both Math 140 and 142. His lectures were very boring and added confusion, plus he talked quietly, and was rude/unhelpful to students. Have to go to class for iClickers and quizzes. Practice exams were not similar to the tests. Does not curve and didn't give partial credit.

I have had prof Sze for both math 140 and 142. He has been a good teacher but like others say, can get lost occasionally and trail off. He explains concepts well and makes it fairly easy to understand. Put in the work and go to week in reviews. Do not put off studying and do practice exams.

Overall not too bad. His lectures can be boring- sometimes he'd trail off and get distracted as he talked. But he explains everything in detail and provides additional example problems. Definitely go to class because he does iClickers on Tuesdays and quizzes on Thursdays. Focus in class, do the work, get help if you're confused and you're chill.

I would definitely say take him if you can!! I had him for both 140 and 142, and he made the content easy to understand in both. His lectures are very boring at times and attendance is mandatory, but they are very helpful and he does a good job explaining concepts. He also does group quizzes. Good professor overall.
Professor Sze made the class not only understandable, but also enjoyable. His lectures were very clear and helped me to really understand the material
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was not extremely difficult, and professor Sze made it easier. His lectures were very clear, and he made the content easy to understand.

I am not the best at calculus but I really enjoyed how he does his lectures.This class gives out a lot of homework and has video lectures you have to do on your own but i highly encourage you to take your time with them because it helps with understanding the concepts. He was very accommodating with making up my exam that I missed for holiday
Super easy!! He's really sweet but he goes really slow during lectures. I almost fell asleep some days.

Prof. Sze is a funny guy with a dry sense of humor. Lectures can feel long and heavy at times. Tuesday contains attendance check through participation iClicker, Thursday contains a quiz--usually w/ allowed cheat sheet. So, COME TO CLASS! There are lectures and WebAssign HW to complete outside of class too, so stay on top of it! Not too difficult!

Great professor. Concepts are easy if you've taken higher-level math classes before. If not, use week-in-reviews to practice concepts. He let us have one page "cheat-sheets" for quizzes and dropped 2 quizzes, homework, iclickers, and video quizzes at the end of the semester. There are many resources available to do well in this class.

The difficulty of Math 140 is entirely based on your background in Math. If you've already excelled in some kind of College Algebra or Pre-Calculus course in high school then this course should be very easy. Professor Sze is great and makes the class very low stress. Everyday there is either a quiz or an iclicker, so attendance is mandatory.

Funny guy although lectures did get a bit long and boring after awhile. None of the content is super hard or unreasonable, even if you are not great at math you will do fine if you work hard. Figuring out how to study is honestly the biggest challenge, the week in reviews were most helpful to me. No extra credit aside from up to 105 on the final.

Professor Sze's lectures were very clear, and his quizzes were exactly like the exams. Very accessible outside of class when I had to make up a quiz, and you're allowed a page of notes you take yourself for every quiz. Your final exam grade waterfalls down to your worst exam grade. He has an iClicker every Tuesday and a quiz every Thursday.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Christopher Sze is a very boring lecturer who at least a third of the time gets the math wrong himself when doing problems. This leads to me often being confused because we went about a problem the wrong way so every time I think I understand what is going on I have to start back at square one.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Even for someone who likes math his lectures were a bit boring and hard to follow. He does gives accessible material and practice exams, a lot of homework and videos to watch as well as 4 exams with the final being worth 20%, there are a few professors that are easier to understand/ pay attention as well as more helpful
Dr.Sze lectures make it very easy to learn the content of the course. If you go to his office hours, he is also very helpful with coursework if you are lost.

He was a very good professor, but you have to be on top of your work, or the class will be hard. It was hard to pay attention sometimes in his class, so make sure you are taking advantage of office hours. Overall, he is a good and fair professor.
He is an amazing professor, he is VERY smart, and his lectures are easy to follow. Just make sure you prepare, show up to class, and review everything, and it will be alright.

Math 140 with Professor Sze was a tolerable class. His lectures are boring- there were maybe two classes the entire semester where I DIDN'T fall asleep. If you're like me (someone who is not good at math and also has a short attention span) his lectures are unhelpful. He mumbles a lot. Also does not like when people ask questions.
Wonderful professor. Very approachable and was willing to help no matter what. Never left anyone in the dark and answered all questions. Very clear with teaching lectures.
Very helpful and cares for his students.  Understands how difficult math may be for students so he tries his best to work with them to make sure they understand.

Exams are 70-80% of your total grade, heavy amount of homework, uses lecture videos by another professor that explains concepts better than he does, overexplains during lectures a lot, quizzes every week that are worth 10-15% grade, harsh grader that doesn't curve at all

Honestly not that bad, just stay on top of the homework, which there are lots. I personally enjoyed his teaching style and he's a genuine and funny guy. The exams make up a lot of the grade because that's for all math150 classes, so you can't blame him. Final replaced lowest and was VERY generous and easy. An A or B is definitely achievable!

Tests are 74% of the grade. Final Exam replaced lowest midterm grade in addition to its own grade, and your two lowest grades in iclicker, quizzes, homework, gets dropped. That's all the extra credit you'll get. Not a bad dude at all, but his teaching style isn't for me. Very hands off and hard to retain (for me at least). Seems like a genuine guy.

Tests make up 74% of grade.~30 questions/test, mix of mult. choice & free response. Rushed over the complex parts of material,but spent excess time over the simpler parts. Gave examples of replacement by a variable by calling it "star" or "question mark", which I didn't enjoy. drops 2 iclickers,2 hws,2 quizzes,final can replace lowest midterm grade
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a good professor. He didn't really care about any questions you had, he would always say “of course I cannot answer that” like huh? Would not take him ever again. the only positive thing about him is that he drops grades at the end of the year.

Amazing professor, I see a lot of people complaining but he isn't half as bad as any other professor. He is extremely kind and caring and easy to reach out to. If you can take him. Any math class here will be hard, it's just less hard with him.
Drops 2 iclickers, 2 webassign, 2 video quizzes and 2 quizzes. I enjoyed his class, even though it was at 530pm.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Other professors gave way easier exams and dropped their students lowest grades, he is the only one that didn't do that. He doesn't care about the students, his goal is to make it extremely hard to get a good grade, not to help his students get a good grade. Take a diff professor, if not possible take this class at community college.

Very funny at times.  Due to a recent law, he does not post completed lecture notes in Canvas but he was kind enough to leave a copy of the notes outside of his office. It was helpful when I had to miss class due to a job interview.

This course was not that bad lowk. He did sometimes get stuff wrong in examples, and slow to teach things, but everything is pretty clearly defined. There is an iclicker every Tuesday, and a quiz every Thursday so attendance, while not explicitly mandatory, is pretty much mandatory. Not a bad prof, kinda a funny guy too

Go to class if you happen to get this prof. As of the time i'm writing this, I don't believe the lecture notes get posted online so to only way to get them is in class. There is a lot of outside class work and it doesn't count for much credit. Tests are weighted very heavily and quizzes only help if you get 100s. Not worth it, take math elsewhere.
Tests are way harder than reviews, hard grader one quizzes. There's a quiz every week and no extra credit given.

Professor Sze really understood the topics and wanted everyone to learn. He gave bonus questions on some exams and really good practice tests that were very similar to the exams. He was very helpful during office hours and answered questions effectively.
He explains the notes very well in lecture and goes over any questions you may have. Office hours are easy and accessible. Tests are very similar to review.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Attendance not mandatory. Went through lecture so fast and didn't explain the concepts or write out steps, instead would skip over things that would have helped us understand. In lecture, I had to copy down the notes to keep up and didn't learn or understand till I did the homework. Didn't answer questions. TAKE AMY AUSTIN OR SHRAEDER INSTEAD!!!!!!
He is a kind professor, but he struggles when explaining certain topics. He would often confuse himself when solving problems on the practice exam, which was concerning.

Took his class last semester. WebAssign (13%), quizzes and group work (15%), video quizzes (3%), iClicker (4%), exams (45%), and final exam (20%). Drops eight grades at the end. Recommend sitting next to smart people because of group quizzes. Use HOGU and Week-in-Reviews. Great at simplifying information. Take your time with group quizzes.

This was Dr. Sze's first time ever teaching 152 and I think he did a fantastic job! I definitely would say if you can't get Schrader or Austin to take Sze. Lectures are good to reference back to when doing the homework, always had a review in math lab before quizzes which were just like the review, and final was extremely easy and fair.

Very straight forward lectures and the class is easy if you pay attention. There are a lot of iclickers and quizzes but he drops the two lowest grades at the end of the semester in each category. His tests are not hard if you prepare and are part free response and part mcq.

Professor Sze does a pretty good job at teaching calculus concepts. In high school I was really bad at math, but after taking Professor Sze I feel really confident in my math abilities. Exams aren't too bad, but they are most of your grade, so prepare a lot for them. Week in reviews will be your best friend for studying.

I enjoyed Prof. Sze's class! However, I took calculus in high school, so I did feel like I had an upper hand compared to students who hadn't learned the material before. His lectures just consist of filling out notes, but if you pay attention, the content isn't difficult. He also drops several grades at the end of the semester! Take him!

Honestly, he truly seemed like he didn't know what he was talking about. A good way to sum up my experience was during an exam review, it took him 34 minutes to complete one problem, and he got it wrong. This was for an exam of 19 questions with only 50 minutes. I ended up getting a tutor halfway through, but I was so far behind in the concepts :(.

He does a really good job of explaining things, and he's quite funny in class. Class was not very hard and if you actually do the homework you should be good. I went to all the HOGU sessions which helped a lot.
He is a very good math 142 professor, his tests are not hard at all, just straight concepts without trying to trick you. He's a little sassy so don't talk in class or he will shout you out lol

Not my first choice, but his exams are objectively easy compared to others. He is kind of sassy, so beware. He also has a thick accent, as well as no extra credit/free grade boost opportunities. Has MANY in-class and take home quizzes, so beware for those! Not bad but not the best

Sze is easily my favorite professor at A&M. Beware, he is a little sassy, but I thought it was silly. He only does group and take-home quizzes, so make smart friends in this class. His exams are really similar to his quizzes, so pay attention to those; he won't try to trick you or make your life harder. If you study well you will definitely succeed

Prof Sze is a very straightforward kind of guy. He tells you what you need to know, explains concepts
generally well, and uses examples to help you understand. He may say things that make students feel a little bad for not knowing something, but that occasion is rare. I would overall recommend his course to someone else.

He worked things out and was engaging, always open to going over stuff and was very descriptive and
methodical in his explanations which is helpful in a math class. Can explain the concept deeply and explain it slow but fast enough for students to understand.

His teaching style is just not good at all. Lectures are super rushed. All his lectures consist of is just him solving problems without really explaining them. Very into the "watch and learn" mentality. Lecture was like watching someone do their math homework. I ended up just using the resources of the math learning center.

He talks in circles, writes things and circles lots of stuff before erasing it just as quickly, and brushes over steps in notes. Zero partial credit on exams. Think he gives the same exam to MWF and TR classes; never run out of time on exams, but with him, I'm never done when time is up. Not a bad guy, not a hard class, but a really bad professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Sze was okay. I always felt like his lectures were too rushed, and we were never truly "learning" the material. He always just wrote a problem and solved it, never really getting into the reasoning behind all the math. Wasn't too bad though, just hard to keep up.
Professor Sze was very kind and professional, but also he seemed approachable and he always made sure we understood the material.

I loved Dr. Sze, the way that he explained everything was so easy to follow and sometimes he would be
surprisingly funny. Homework helped with learning the concepts, but I wish they had feedback on how to do the problem if it was incorrect.

This course content with mildly difficult, however, Prof. Sze made it easier to understand by providing content in classes. He made class enjoyable, definitely laughed a ton, which made me want to go to class even though the class was late.

To do well in this class you really need to have taken calculus before. He is not the best lecturer, doesn't take time to explain so it feels like youre just watching him fill out notes for his own sake. He is tough on grading and partial credit, do not expect him to do you any favors in that department or curve. Hard tests.

Great professor for Calc II.  It's his first time teaching Calc II at A&M, but I felt like he'd been teaching it for many many years. Very knowledgeable and knows the content inside and out. Some comments from 140/142 sugest that he does not know the material. This is IMPOSSIBLE. The guy has a PhD and 140/142 is like 1+1 for anyone with a Math PhD.

Very hard to understand and exams are very hard. He doesn't do a good job of explaining things and sounds confused often which isn't good for someone like me who isn't good at math. I would not recommend him if you struggle with math, choose a different professor. Virtual math learning center will be your friend.

He was funny! drops the two lowest grades of each section (except exams obv), meaning you can miss a couple quizzes+iclickers, but there are also a lot of them and weigh enough to force you to go to class. TAMU makes this course resource abundant so it's really easy to get extra practice/help

I am HORRIBLE at math. I've dropped this class before, so when taking it with Sze I was very nervous to start this class. He is so helpful to those who struggle with the material, exams are VERY straight forward. He doesn't try to trick you, and as long as you study the practice exams and webassigns, exams are pretty easy.

The professor is great and is funny. Make sure to go to class as there are many in-class group works that count toward your grade a lot. I made the mistake of missing a few classes and it almost cost me my A. He drops 2 of your lowest grades from each section and replaces your lowest test grade with your final. Show up to class, should be an easy A

I love Professor Sze! He teaches super well and he makes a lot of funny jokes in class. His tests are also easy and he drops your lowest quiz, groupwork, and homework grades. Totally recommend taking him for math 140 if you want to do good!

Prof. Sze has a great personality, but I found his class difficult. I'm not the best at math, and he didn't explain concepts clearly. The class is test-heavy, with 3 exams making up 45% of your grade, which can really impact your GPA. I wouldn't recommend him, but if you have no choice, seek help from him, the TA, or a tutor.

The class itself is very easy, but Mr. Sze's teaching style was just not for me. You have to watch video notes before class but then he would spend the first 20 minutes repeating the material covered in the video. Still a very straightforward class and the assignments given in class take the grade burden off of the exams a bit.

The content is not that hard, but I do not think he did the best job of explaining it. He has a great and interesting sense of humor to him. His tests were pretty easy, but sometimes, he can just be confusing. That being said, I would definitely take him again because I feel like he did a pretty good job.

He explains things very clearly and in great detail. As long as you pay attention in class and study somewhat for the tests, you'll get an A. His tests aren't tricky or difficult. There's some in-class activities but they're super easy. He's also very funny during class.

I got Professor Sze as my random math professor and I am so thankful! He makes the concepts easy to understand and if they are more difficult, he goes into more depth. Take him as he is always willing to answer questions and help students. Hes also super funny unironically!

He kinda sounds like he dosen't know what he's talking about half the time, and isn't the best at explaining difficult concepts but he's not the worst prof ever. His tests are said to be "easy" but they really aren't. You have to go to class because he does a bunch of group works so make sure the people you sit around are smart.

Professor Sze explained the concepts and skills concisely and effectively. If I asked a question, he always provided a clear answer. He was also very funny, and I looked forward to going to his class. I would definitely take him again and recommend him.

I feel lucky to have gotten professor Sze after hearing how my other friends profs were like. He was engaging and helpful, even to that one kid in class who never stopped talking. I found his extra examples extremely helpful. I've never been good at math, but professor Sze helped me.
He is challenging to understand and often seems unconfident in what he teaches. I got an A, but it took a lot of effort and self-teaching to achieve it.
I LOVE SZE. One of my fave professors so far. Made calculus understandable and was available to help if needed.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: 1st test was comparatively much easier than 2nd and 3rd. He knows what he is teaching, however, sometimes I feel like he doesn't know how to explain concepts in an orderly manner. He goes backwards sometimes to re-explain himself and that is confusing at times. His take-home quizzes and group quizzes are very easy. Study ALL week-in reviews!
He was very good and made the concepts easy to understand. I would definitely recommend him as a Math 142 professor. The exams weren't too difficult and the group quizzes were easy.

Professor Sze was really cool and randomly funny! Some people might not like him cause they think he is a hard grader but 142 can be hard if you are not a math person. He gives extra examples and is avaible all the time for office hours. Also use your TAs cause they are very good.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment:
If you have trouble with math and need to take this course, take this class!! I had to drop this course the previous semester because I had so much trouble, but he made the concepts so much easier to understand. 
I 100% think he is the best professor in the math department. Beware to show up to class for iClicker grades and in-class group work.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Great prof, especially if you're not a math person (like me). Lectures are boring but I just don't like math, so take that with a grain of salt. He cares about his students and can be so randomly funny out of nowhere. I recommend!
He explains problems slowly so that average students can follow along and clearly states the reasoning behind each step. Perfect for arts majors who are not math people.

fairly easy and class and his lectures were detailed + posted notes online so if you missed class you could still study. does have participation grade via iclicker but nice professor and good teaching, just lots of homework.

As a student who has experience with Calc BC in high school, I find this class extremely easy. The class is pretty much alg2 and precal with some business in it. Prof Sze is a funny guy, he makes good jokes that make the class laugh. For tests, just study the class lecture notes, and you will do fine. Easiest class that I've taken first sem.

For a person who hates math, this class was not too bad. His lectures lowkey made me fall asleep multiple times, but he can be funny af. I honestly didn't really learn a lot of precalc? It was a lot of random math stuff that we had to learn.

Despite a good half of the course being simple concepts, Dr. Sze knows how to simplify topics which is super helpful for when content gets more complicated. He has in-class participation type things on Fridays, so show up. Exams are very simple and reflect what he gives in class. He is also funny overall best math teacher I've ever had! Take him!

Great professor. He explains concepts thoroughly and will generally march through multiple examples. Many concepts are upper high school level so overall the material is pretty easy. Prof Sze also has a good sense of humor which lightens up the class. For example, he once called a dashed line "malnourished."
Overall, Professor Sze was a great prof and was really funny. I would 100% take him next semester if I could. He showed so many examples and cared about you doing well on the exams.

Chrissy Sze is the best professor I've ever had. He's so funny and he explains difficult concepts so well and in different ways for students to understand. I genuinely will miss him so much I wish he was teaching Math 142. IF YOU CAN, TAKE HIM!!!! I love this man to death.

He is very good at telling the class what we need to know and explaining how to do different math concepts. Although the class is large, I feel like Mr. Sze has time for everyone and is always available to assist.

He is amazing and I have heard horror stories about other MATH140 profs. He teaches very well, does not give quizzes, and his tests are easy. He is also funny and makes himself available to students. Don't be worried about the small number of reviews, this is his first semester at A&M so he hasn't had many students yet. Overall a great guy!

Prof. Sze was by far the best instructor that I have ever had in terms of a math course. Naturally, I struggle with math and excel in English and other subjects but in math I have a very hard time even understanding the basics of algebra, however, he was very thorough in explaining how things happened and made it much easier for me to understand.

Teaches what's necessary and skips over what you don't need to know. The focus of grades was online homework and quizzes. You teach yourself by watching videos and going over the textbook; he, for the most part, reviews and makes things more digestible. GO TO CLASS!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes
